description: NaFe₅O₈ is Spinel-like structured and crystallizes in the cubic P4_332 space group. Na is bonded to six equivalent O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent FeO₄ tetrahedra and edges with six equivalent FeO₆ octahedra. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.30 Å. There are two inequivalent Fe sites. In the first Fe site, Fe is bonded to four O atoms to form FeO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent NaO₆ octahedra and corners with nine equivalent FeO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 51-63°. There are three shorter (1.93 Å) and one longer (1.99 Å) Fe-O bond length. In the second Fe site, Fe is bonded to six O atoms to form FeO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent FeO₄ tetrahedra, edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, and edges with four equivalent FeO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Fe-O bond distances ranging from 2.02-2.09 Å. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to one Na and three Fe atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded to four Fe atoms to form distorted corner-sharing OFe₄ trigonal pyramids.
